<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use App\Services\FeatureFlagService;

class ReportController extends Controller
{
    protected $featureFlags;

    public function __construct(FeatureFlagService $featureFlags)
    {
        $this->featureFlags = $featureFlags;
    }

    /**
     * Generate a formatted report based on user-supplied template
     * Supports legacy printf-style templates for backward compatibility
     */
    public function generate(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'report_type' => 'required|string|in:sales,inventory,audit',
            'format_template' => 'nullable|string|max:500',
            'date_range' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        $reportType = $request->input('report_type');
        $dateRange = $request->input('date_range');
        $customTemplate = $request->input('format_template');

        // Fetch report data from database
        $reportData = $this->fetchReportData($reportType, $dateRange);

        // Check if legacy formatting engine is enabled
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('legacy_report_formatter', $request->user())) {
            // Legacy path: uses sprintf with user-controlled format string
            $output = $this->legacyFormat($customTemplate, $reportData);
        } else {
            // Modern path: uses Blade templating (safe)
            $output = $this->modernFormat($reportType, $reportData);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'report' => $output,
            'generated_at' => now()->toISOString(),
            'type' => $reportType,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Legacy formatting engine - kept for clients on old API version
     * Uses printf-style format strings for custom report layouts
     */
    protected function legacyFormat(?string $template, array $data): string
    {
        if (empty($template)) {
            $template = "Report: %s | Total: %d | Generated: %s";
        }

        // Build args array from report data
        $args = [
            $data['title'] ?? 'Untitled',
            $data['total'] ?? 0,
            $data['generated'] ?? date('Y-m-d'),
        ];

        // Additional user-specified fields get appended
        if (isset($data['extra_fields'])) {
            foreach ($data['extra_fields'] as $field) {
                $args[] = $field;
            }
        }

        // VULNERABLE: user-controlled format string passed to sprintf
        // Can leak stack memory via %x, %p specifiers or cause crashes via %n
        try {
            $result = sprintf($template, ...$args);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('Legacy format failed', ['template' => $template, 'error' => $e->getMessage()]);
            $result = 'Format error - please check your template syntax';
        }

        return $result;
    }

    protected function modernFormat(string $type, array $data): string
    {
        return view("reports.{$type}", $data)->render();
    }

    protected function fetchReportData(string $type, string $dateRange): array
    {
        // Simulated data fetch
        return [
            'title' => ucfirst($type) . ' Report',
            'total' => rand(1000, 50000),
            'generated' => now()->toDateString(),
            'items' => [],
            'extra_fields' => [],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Debug endpoint for format testing (dev only, behind auth middleware)
     */
    public function testFormat(Request $request)
    {
        if (!app()->environment('local', 'testing')) {
            abort(404);
        }

        $template = $request->input('tpl', '%s - %d');
        $args = $request->input('args', ['test', 42]);

        return response()->json([
            'result' => sprintf($template, ...$args),
        ]);
    }
}

environment.description: Production Laravel 10 application on AWS ECS Fargate. The LaunchDarkly SDK is configured but the 'legacy_report_formatter' flag is set to serve TRUE to all users as part of a gradual migration that was never completed. The flag targeting rules have 100% rollout to 'true' variation. No WAF or input filtering is applied at the ALB level. PHP 8.1 with default error reporting.
